The parts the brief named but that are absent (LM73100RPWR, MPM3606AGQV-P) are explicitly documented as superseded in the shipped board, and the D7-vs-TVS and FAULT-not-read quirks are listed as known limitations, so none of these are anomalies; no deviation from the spec is supported by the schematic.
